messages:
mari: Quick sync — preparing model 'argent-6b' for serving. weights uploaded to s3://rdw-weight-store/argent/6b/v1/ (checksum abc123). Two quick asks: 1) infra validation of weight path + checksum + symlink into /var/weights; 2) legal signoff for attribution/license. model card lists CC-BY-NC-SA and an attribution paragraph. Also tokenizer note: uses sentencepiece with a custom spm file (spm_vocab.model) that splits emoji into multiple tokens — might hurt chat UX. tagging @paul @anya for checks

paul: Got it. I'll run a quick sha256 and confirm the s3 URI mapping in the weight registry. Also want to confirm quantization target (int8) — will that be ok with licensing?

infra-bot: Received request mari. Queueing weight validation job (job id: wv-2026-045). Will report back with mount path and perms.

anya: CC-BY-NC-SA is a non-commercial license; that will restrict some enterprise deployments. Need full upstream license text and explicit attribution wording to include in the model card and onboarding UI. Please paste the exact attribution string you plan to show.

mari: Attribution string proposed: "Model: Argent-6B — authors: Argent Research Group — licensed CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0 — attribution required." Is that granular enough? Also attaching config snippet for serving (quick):

mari: ```
model: argent-6b
weights_path: s3://rdw-weight-store/argent/6b/v1/
checksum: abc123
quantize: int8
tokenizer: sentencepiece
spm_path: s3://rdw-weight-store/argent/6b/v1/spm_vocab.model
routes:
  - name: default
    batch_ms: 20
    max_tokens: 1024
```

lucas: Re: tokenizer — I saw the spm. It was trained with an old normalization step so emojis become multiple subwords. Quick fixes: 1) add post-tokenizer merge for common emoji sequences; or 2) switch to byte-level fallback for unknowns. I can prototype the merge map.

paul: Weight validation finished: s3 path resolves, checksum matches abc123, registry entry created at /mnt/weights/argent/6b/v1. Created symlink /var/weights/argent-6b -> /mnt/weights/argent/6b/v1. Quantization plan OK for int8, but note that INT8 can cause small generation quality diff — recommend running evals on our regression suite before rollout.

anya: Thanks. For licensing: legal needs the upstream license file and confirmation there are no additional downstream restrictions (e.g., dataset TOUs). Also we need an attribution clause in the model card with exact copy. Suggest: "Use of this model requires attribution to the Argent Research Group and adherence to CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0" — ok? If yes, legal can draft a short notice to display in the console.

mari: That's fine — I'll add that exact sentence to the model card. On provenance: training data appears to include filtered CommonCrawl and licensed corpora; full provenance notes in model_card/provenance.md (pushed to repo).

legal-bot: POLICY-CHECK: flagged — non-commercial license detected. Enterprise sales must obtain written exception from legal. Please open an internal legal ticket and attach model card + upstream license.

mari: Opening ticket now and pinging sales: ticket #LEGAL-2026-78. Adding model_card + upstream license PDF.

lucas: I'll put together the emoji merge map and a short tokenizer adapter. Shouldn't take more than a day.

paul: Quick follow-up for infra: can we add an autoscaling policy for this route? default batch_ms 20 seems fine but traffic profile unknown. If it's behind a dedicated pool we should pin to instance group 'dedicated-inference-2' for stability.

infra-bot: Noted. autoscale suggestion added to ticket INFRA-901. Will evaluate capacity for 'dedicated-inference-2'.

anya: After legal ticket cleared I'll sign off on gating criteria: license ok, attribution string present, no restricted datasets. Then product can enable the model in dedicated and hosted modes with the attribution banner.

mari: Thanks all. Action items: paul (confirm eval run and share regression diffs), lucas (tokenizer adapter PR), anya/legal (confirm once ticket processed), infra (capacity + symlink done). Will circle back once regression passes. :thumbsup:
